metadata.name: sheetView
metadata.description: (cfg editing draft mount error keys vals srcs geom selected selectedSrc) - spreadsheet RenderSpec producer: each worksheet table wrapped in a draggable window frame. Single-click SELECTS a cell (origin.select sets 元.selected) and the cell KEEPS rendering its value; the window's formula bar shows the SELECTED cell's source (bound to 元.draft) and commits on Enter (origin.key) to 元.selected. Double-click opens the inline editor. The bar's LEFT button is 🔫 fire (origin.fire — re-evaluate the selected cell); the right is ? wiki. The bar textarea has no max-height (resize:vertical, box-sizing:border-box) so it can fill the window. Cells render clean (no per-cell ✎/? glyphs). The titlebar shows exactly one of ◱ (mid/restore, when maximized) and ⛶ (maximize, when not), plus – minimize and ✕ close.

metadata.name: winsheet.close
metadata.description: close (hide; restorable from the taskbar — never destroyed)

metadata.name: winsheet.stop
metadata.description: stop button press starting a drag

metadata.name: winsheet.maximize
metadata.description: (state, seg) - maximize a worksheet window to the viewport and set win.geom[seg].max=1 so the titlebar swaps ⛶ for ◱ (mid/restore).

metadata.name: winsheet.mid
metadata.description: (state, seg) - reset a worksheet window to a mid size and clear win.geom[seg].max so the titlebar shows ⛶ (maximize) again.

metadata.name: winsheet.tab
metadata.description: switch the active tab of a host window

metadata.name: winsheet.tearoff
metadata.description: tear a tab out of its host into a standalone window

metadata.name: winsheet.newtab
metadata.description: (state, host) - the '+' on a worksheet window's tab strip: genesis-create a BLANK 10x10 sheet, mint it as its own private closure, tab it into the clicked window (win.geom[new].host=host), and bundle the host clique so the new tab shares memory with its host.

metadata.name: winsheet.syncBundles
metadata.description: (state) - make SEEDED tab relationships grant shared memory like a runtime drop does: scan win.geom and bundleSegments each {host, tabs...} clique, so a sheet minted private-get (a closure) can read its host's cels when win.geom seeds seg.host (e.g. turtlecharts tabbed into turtles reads turtles!). Idempotent; the host calls it after the desktop genesis materializes.
